mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp91_menu_info_notice (emp91_menu_info_notice_id, emp91_menu_id, emp91_date, emp91_person_id) VALUES (f_create_seq(), #{menuId}, f_today(), #{personId})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp91_menu_info_notice SET emp91_date = f_today() WHERE emp91_menu_id = #{menuId} AND emp91_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM emp91_menu_info_notice WHERE emp91_menu_id = #{menuId} AND emp91_person_id = #{personId}
